MRI Information
The Pylon Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 1,200 G/cm (12 T/m).
- Gradient slew rate ≤ 100 T/m/s (per axis).
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Body transmit coil or head transmit coil.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- B1+RMS of 3.6 uT or less; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg.
3 T scanning conditions:
- WB-SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg.
- Limit total active scanning to 30 min.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
